snippet.title: Gothic 1 Remake | Making Of #04: Story
snippet.description:
"I was very happy because it's not often in life that you get a second chance."

Join Mattias Filler, who was part of the original Gothic games, and the team at Alkimia Interactive and take a look behind the scenes of Gothic 1 Remake, diving deep into the challenges of reviving a cult classic RPG.  From fixing old plot holes to more side quests, all while staying true to the original – this video showcases how refining each camp’s storyline, improving NPC routines and even creating a full Orcish language results in a more immersive yet faithful remake.
